Soundwalk open-source credits

Soundwalk application code: Copyright 2026 wenye li. Apache License 2.0.

MediaPipe Tasks Audio 1.1.0
Copyright The MediaPipe Authors. Apache License 2.0.
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-audio/v/1.1.0
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Runtime license: vendor/LICENSE
The runtime's README documents on-device input processing and performance/utilization metrics sent to Google. Soundwalk hosts the runtime and model on its own origin and uses Content-Security-Policy connect-src 'self' to block connections to other origins. No external CDN or API is needed for model inference.

YAMNet classification model
Copyright Google. Apache License 2.0.
https://www.kaggle.com/models/google/yamnet/tfLite/classification-tflite/1
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/audio_classifier/yamnet/float32/1/yamnet.tflite
https://github.com/tensorflow/models/tree/master/research/audioset/yamnet
License included: models/LICENSE
521 broad sound-event classes. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. This is not a bird species classifier.
